subject: Who signs the budget? Checklist + legal/security next steps
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@clearwell.health>, Jamal Pierce <jamal.pierce@clearwell.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + who signs off on budget (post-call)

Hi Emma / Jamal — thanks again for the time this morning, appreciate the clarity on the clinical use-case and scale expectations. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment:

- What we heard: ClearWell wants a 6–8 week POC to validate inference throughput on de-identified clinical notes and measure latency under your peak patterns. Target: 50k requests/day, average seq len ~1k tokens.
- Success criteria discussed: <=200ms median token latency, integrated audit logs for 90-day retention, and proof of no PHI persistence in logs.
- Key unknowns we want to resolve: who owns budget approval (finance/legal sign-off), procurement intake timeline, and any additional security artifacts beyond SOC 2 Type II (e.g., architecture diagram, KMS controls).

Ask / next steps:
1) Could you confirm the funding owner and the procurement contact we should put on the MAP? If budget is owned by finance, please share the approver name & title so we can route the contracting flow correctly.
2) I'm attaching a one-page POC funding checklist (POC-Funding-Checklist.xlsx) and a short list of security artifacts we can produce. Please review and flag anything we missed.
3) Proposed next call: 30 minutes next week to align procurement + security milestones. I'm free Tue/Wed morning PT.

If easier, Jamal or your procurement team can loop in a rep at procurement@clearwell.health and we'll share a high-level mutual action plan and an initial SOW draft.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to a short POC that proves economics.

— Olga Petrov
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-Funding-Checklist.xlsx (attachment), SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf (attachment)

From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@clearwell.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Pierce <jamal.pierce@clearwell.health>, procurement@clearwell.health
Date: 2026-10-11T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + who signs off on budget (post-call)

Thanks, Olga — great summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Funding owner: Michael Hsu, VP Finance (michael.hsu@clearwell.health) signs off on new vendor spend > $50k. I’ll loop him into the MAP once we have the rough SOW and expected spend.
- Procurement: Jamal (cc’d) manages the intake and will open a purchase requisition; procurement@clearwell.health is the intake mailbox.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is baseline; we will request an architecture diagram and confirmation of in-transit encryption and KMS usage. Also include an approximate data retention and deletion policy for logs.

Procurement timeline: typical internal SLA is 3–4 weeks for small pilots if the SOW and PO are clean; if legal needs redlines it could extend.

I’ll ask Jamal to propose two slots for next week.

Best,
Emma Lawson
Head of Product Operations
ClearWell Health

Thanks Emma — looping Michael to be efficient. Michael, quick note on intent: ClearWell is evaluating a short POC to validate inference latency and audit logging for clinical notes (no PHI persisted). Estimated pilot spend runs in the mid 10s of thousands depending on duration — we can size for the smallest meaningful slice to prove the economics and performance.

Attached is the POC funding checklist and the minimal set of security artifacts we can provide up front (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, KMS usage statement). If you’d prefer, we can first run a short controlled demo with your engineering team before we draft a PO.

Proposed next steps:
- Jamal / procurement: open PR and share expected intake date.
- Michael: if OK, confirm whether we should route the PO through your vendor onboarding team or if procurement will handle.
- Everyone: a 30-min alignment call Tuesday 10/13 or Wednesday 10/14 (I recommended Tue/Wed morning PT).

On logistics, we can provide a redline-friendly SOW and a plug-and-play MAP so legal sees the minimal terms up front.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a proposed time and Michael’s note on routing.

— Olga

Olga / Marissa — quick internal note: Emma confirmed Michael Hsu as the approver and Jamal will run procurement intake. I recommend we: 

1) Offer a concise 6-week pilot SOW at a discounted pilot rate (10% off list) to reduce friction — ask approval for up to $8k discretionary credit for POC.
2) Prep a single-page security packet (SOC 2 summary, diagram, KMS statement) to send to Jamal by EOD tomorrow.
3) Draft MAP with procurement milestones and send to procurement@clearwell.health once Jamal confirms the intake ticket.

Olga — if you’re comfortable, approve the $8k pilot credit and I’ll send the SOW + MAP.
